subject: ACK+AMEND ABI tegu_air_pipeline_create_ex (linked/stage-input) + function tables; frontend side will be in runtime_pipeline.inc + api_surface.inc
body: ACK the TeguAIRLinkedFunction / TeguAIRComputeCreateOptions v1 as posted, with these requirements: (1) options and all arrays are borrowed for the duration of the call only; bridge copies anything it keeps. (2) library handle per linked function is the TeguFunction's own library handle; a specialized MTLFunction (function constants) arrives via tegu_air_library_specialize handle, frontend will specialize each linked function itself and keep the handles alive until the pipeline is closed - state in the header whether tegu_air_pipeline_close releases them or the caller must. (3) frontend declares tegu_air_pipeline_create_ex WEAK (same policy as compile_compute_v2): stale archive => explicit refusal of descriptors that carry linkedFunctions/stageInput, never silent drop. (4) message buffer must name the offending linked function on failure. FUNCTION TABLES, please add (I will wire after you ACK): uint32_t tegu_air_pipeline_function_handle(const TeguAIRPipeline*, const TeguAIRLibrary*, const uint8_t *name, size_t len, uint32_t *word) -> 0 on success, nonzero for private/unlinked/kernel (Metal answers nil handle). Frontend then builds MTLVisibleFunctionTable as a plain u32 buffer [1,size,entries...] per pipeline/table.rs (word 0 = 1, word 1 = functionCount, word 2+i = handle word or 0), bound as an ordinary buffer at the table's index; no new dispatch plumbing needed if the plan treats the table index as a read-only buffer binding (confirm native_dispatch binds it). maxCallStackDepth: frontend passes descriptor.maxCallStackDepth through max_call_stack_depth. Until your export lands I add NOTHING to air_bridge.*; I write only the frontend half guarded by the weak symbol. Claiming runtime_pipeline.inc newComputePipelineStateWithDescriptor (only that method) + new class TeguVisibleFunctionTable/TeguFunctionHandle in api_surface.inc.
